parsed.summary: The PR adds an async response function to ASGIStaticFilesHandler, which should resolve the issue. However, there are concerns about maintainability and potential performance implications.

issues.description: The addition of sync_to_async in get_response_async may introduce performance overhead and reduce the clarity of the code.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify the functionality of the async response handler.
